title: NexVigilant Bot Tunnel
description: Public ML signal detection endpoints for AI agents. No auth required. Live FAERS disproportionality + ML random forest scoring in one call.

tools.name: bot-signal-run
tools.description: Run ML + statistical signal detection for 8 default drugs or custom targets. Returns PRR/ROR/IC + live ML probability for each drug-event pair. No auth required.

parameters.name: drug
parameters.description: Filter to a specific drug (optional — omit for all 8 defaults)

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Specific adverse event to check (requires drug parameter)

tools.name: bot-signal-custom
tools.description: Run ML + statistical signal detection for custom drug-event targets (up to 20). POST with targets array.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Array of {drug, event, harm?} objects to analyze (max 20)

tools.name: bot-stream-connect
tools.description: Connect to SSE live broadcast stream. Returns real-time signal detection events as they arrive (health, ml_model, signal, complete). Use for live monitoring dashboards.
